tasks.title: Live-root reconciliation: discover_live_roots over config + __main__
acceptance_criteria: harness/wire_up.py exposes a new top-level function discover_live_roots(repo_root) -> list[str]
discover_live_roots unions the shipped LIVE_ROOTS with config-registered entrypoints and __main__-bearing modules
tasks.objective: Add a pure, stdlib-only function discover_live_roots(repo_root) -> list[str] to the EXISTING module harness/wire_up.py that reconciles the live-root seed set from ground truth, curing the stale LIVE_ROOTS constant so the config-registered hook entrypoints are seeded and the hooks subsystem (e.g. harness/hooks/_paths.py) no longer reports orphan.

spec.objective: Add a pure, stdlib-only function discover_live_roots(repo_root) -> list[str] to the EXISTING module harness/wire_up.py that reconciles the live-root seed set from ground truth, curing the stale LIVE_ROOTS constant so the config-registered hook entrypoints are seeded and the hooks subsystem (e.g. harness/hooks/_paths.py) no longer reports orphan.
functional_requirements: Add ONE new top-level function discover_live_roots(repo_root) -> list[str] to harness/wire_up.py. Do NOT change LIVE_ROOTS, WireResult, check_wired, or _grep_config behaviour.

discover_live_roots returns a sorted, de-duplicated list of module rel-paths (POSIX, e.g. 'harness/hooks/claude/pre_tool.py') that is the UNION of: (a) the shipped LIVE_ROOTS entries that exist as files under repo_root; (b) entrypoints registered by name in config/**; (c) discovered non-test modules whose source contains an `if __name__ == '__main__'` block.

Source (b): scan every file under repo_root/config (recursively) for two reference forms and convert each to a module rel-path that exists in the discovered module set: (b1) a '-m <dotted.module>' token (e.g. 'harness.hooks.claude.pre_tool' -> 'harness/hooks/claude/pre_tool.py'); (b2) a literal path ending in '.py' (e.g. '${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/harness/hook_pre_tool.py' -> 'harness/hook_pre_tool.py'). Only keep candidates that are present in the discovered non-test module set.
Use harness.rebuild.discover.discover_modules(Path(repo_root)) to get the authoritative non-test module rel-path set; never invent rel-paths that are not in it.
Pure: stdlib only (re, pathlib, collections). No process spawn, model/API/network call, or un-injected subprocess. Only filesystem reads under repo_root.
spec.interfaces: discover_live_roots(repo_root) -> list[str]  # sorted unique union of shipped LIVE_ROOTS (existing) + config/**-registered entrypoints (-m dotted modules and *.py paths that exist as discovered modules) + discovered modules carrying an `if __name__ == '__main__'` block. Lives in harness/wire_up.py beside the unchanged LIVE_ROOTS / WireResult / check_wired / _grep_config seams. Consumes harness.rebuild.discover.discover_modules(source_root) -> (modules, tests, seeds) unchanged.
edge_cases: A config reference to a module that is NOT in the discovered module set (e.g. a stdlib module or a typo) is dropped, not returned.
A shipped LIVE_ROOTS entry whose file does not exist under repo_root is still acceptable to include OR drop, but the function must never raise on a missing file.

Internal modules that are merely imported (e.g. harness/hooks/_paths.py, harness/wire_up.py) are NOT entrypoints and must NOT appear in the result unless they independently match source (a), (b), or (c).
The function must be deterministic: same repo_root -> identical sorted list.
non_goals: No change to LIVE_ROOTS, WireResult, check_wired, or _grep_config -- this leaf ADDS one function only.
No reimplementation of discover.module_import_graph or discover_modules.
No process spawn, model/API/network call, or un-injected subprocess; only stdlib + discover + filesystem reads under repo_root.
No integration into sweep_modules, the accept path, or the overseer gates -- those are separate leaves.

unit_tests: discover_live_roots returns a sorted str list that is a superset of the existing shipped roots
config-registered hook entrypoints (harness/hooks/claude/pre_tool.py, harness/mcp_server.py, harness/hook_pre_tool.py) are in the result
internal non-entrypoint modules (harness/wire_up.py, harness/hooks/_paths.py) are not in the result
harness/hooks/_paths.py classifies WIRED under the reconciled roots
a synthetic zero-importer module is still ORPHAN
test_spec.test_data_requirements: Runs against the real repo tree (config/** + harness/hooks/** present from the parent-HEAD archive) plus a tmp synthetic tree for the orphan assertion -- supplied by the committed oracle.
